title: PHPConf.Asia 2018 - Call for Speakers
content:
Announcing - The Pan-Asian PHP Conference - CFP Opens NowPHPConf.Asia 2018

The third pan-Asian PHP conference will take place between 26 to 29 September 2018 in - the Garden City of the East! This is a single track, 2 days (27 to 28 September 2018). Followed by 1 day of on 29 September 2018.thththththSingaporeConferenceTutorials

Come and meet with the fastest growing PHP communities in Asia. More than 300 attendees are expected in this single track conference.
